title: SAT Right Triangles & Trig: SOHCAHTOA and Special Right Triangles
description:
Right triangle questions on the SAT come down to a few tools: the Pythagorean theorem, two special right triangles, and three trig ratios. This lesson covers each one, shows how the SAT tests it, and works through 7 SAT-style practice questions that get harder as they go.

You'll learn:
• The Pythagorean theorem and the triples worth memorizing (3-4-5, 5-12-13, 8-15-17)
• The 30-60-90 and 45-45-90 triangles from the reference sheet
• SOHCAHTOA, and how to label opposite and adjacent from the correct angle
• Why the sine of an angle equals the cosine of its complement
• Why similar right triangles share the same trig ratios
• A quick note on radians
• A 4-step method for any right triangle question

All questions are original SAT-style questions written for this video, not official College Board questions. For official practice, use the free SAT Suite Question Bank (Geometry and Trigonometry, skill: Right triangles and trigonometry).
